lines.l: Now, I will give you, I am the start
It's you that my heart beats to, it's fascinating
Joy I will share with love and opinion
Life will be fair, with more ups and downs
Take away the frowns, put a smile on your face
But the special love, even time can erase
Ooh, I'm doing it all for you, babe
I said I'm a fool, all that I have
I'm a man in love, now who to blame?
Your love I will cherish, like mountains of gold
I'll give you the world, so let's let you be
Your every command, I will fill with it
Oh, doing it all for you, baby
Like the stars in the sky
Baby, now I'm the one that you very love
And you're the rhythm and the rhyme to the song
Across the ocean, over the mountains, in the city, at work, and during your free time
